purpose: Isolated v5 diagnosis and correction for zeroed complement skin weights; no production files changed.

priorRun.failure: Structured CDP payload reports Pose-witness skin weights do not sum to one at vertex 0: 0.

cause: The source weight accessor is normalized integer storage. V4 computes fractional barycentric weights but passes those fractions directly to the original integer typed-array constructor. Values below one truncate to zero. V5 writes the generated weights to a Float32BufferAttribute, preserves per-bone barycentric support, and rejects non-finite/negative/non-unit rows.
execution: Source-prepared only. No v5 tests, bundle, asset parse, browser, or visual validation has run. Root owns review and any remote publication/execution.
